newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Friday roundup -USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a limited test.
Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers and 900 heifers after a weekly movement of 131,700 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers: Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs $63.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs $63.00.
Confirmed: 1,100 Week Ago: 44,400 Year Ago: None
